basic_details.job_title: AIIMS Project Technical Support II Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Obstetrics and Gynaecology, All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), New Delhi, is filling one temporary Project Technical Support-II post in an ICMR funded project on a contractual basis. The pay is Rs. 20,000 plus 30% HRA. The essential qualification is 12th in science with a Diploma (MLT/DMLT) and five years of experience in the relevant subject. A detailed CV must be submitted by 15 November 2026 in Room No. 731, 7th Floor, Mother & Child Building, AIIMS New Delhi, and sent to [email protected].

how_to_apply: Submit the CV by 15/11/2026 in Room No. 731, 7th Floor, Mother & Child Building, AIIMS New Delhi.
Send the CV by email to [email protected].
The notice names only the detailed CV as the document to submit. It prints no application form and no email subject line.
important_instructions: No TA/DA will be given for attending the interview. All rights are reserved with the P.I. No enquiries shall be entertained. Age relaxation is as per ICMR rules.

content_sections.heading: About AIIMS New Delhi Obstetrics and Gynaecology Project
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by the Department of Obstetrics and Gynaecology of the All India Institute of Medical Sciences, New Delhi. It is headed "Contractual Vacancy Notice" and invites applications for a temporary post in an ICMR funded project. The notice does not print the project title or the tenure.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The age limit is up to 30 years. The notice adds "Age relaxation as per ICMR rules" and does not list the relaxation by category. It prints no cut-off date for counting age. Candidates should check the official notice for any further eligibility details.

rows.qualification_and_essential_requirements: 12th in science + Diploma (MLT/DMLT) + Five-year experience in relevant subject

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The pay for Project Technical Support-II is printed as 20,000+30% HRA. The notice describes the post as temporary and the vacancy as contractual. It does not mention the length of the contract.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS New Delhi Project Technical Support-II
content_sections.text: Prepare a detailed CV. Submit the CV by 15/11/2026 in Room No. 731, 7th Floor, Mother & Child Building, AIIMS New Delhi. Send the CV by email to [email protected] . The notice names only the detailed CV as the document to submit. It prints no application form and no email subject line.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates will be invited for interviews. The notice does not give the interview date, venue or the shortlisting criteria. No TA/DA will be given for attending the interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be given for attending the interview. All rights are reserved with the P.I. No enquiries shall be entertained. Age relaxation is as per ICMR rules.
